title: Recover the genuine generator recipe for signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1
outcome: resolved -- generator recovered and authenticity demonstrated

raw_file_hash_comparison.method: sha256 of every recipe/workflow-shaped file committed under assets/src/concept/, plus every other committed ComfyUI-workflow-shaped JSON found elsewhere in assets/src/, checked against the provenance's recorded workflow_hash.
raw_file_hash_comparison.conclusion: INVALID CHECK, superseded below. No committed file's raw sha256 matches workflow_hash -- but workflow_hash is never defined as the sha256 of a file on disk (see rendered_graph_hash_comparison). This round's negative result was a false signal from comparing against the wrong quantity, not evidence the recipe is inauthentic. Two of the candidates checked here (_comfyui_props_workflow.json, _comfyui_structure_workflow.json) DO match other sheets' recorded workflow_hash values under the correct definition, which is what exposed the error.

rendered_graph_hash_comparison.method: The provenance seam's actual definition (tools/comfy-client/src/comfy_client/workflow.py:152-155): workflow_hash = sha256(json.dumps(render_workflow(recipe), sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) over the RENDERED GRAPH, not any file's raw bytes. Loaded assets/src/concept/signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.recipe.json via comfy_client.recipe.load_recipe(), rendered it with comfy_client.workflow.render_workflow() (default sdxl_txt2img_v1 template), and hashed the result with comfy_client.workflow.workflow_hash(). Run via assets/src/concept/_t0236_verify.py (scratch script, not committed) through /home/dennieseth/dev/lora-train-venv/bin/python3 -- render_workflow/workflow_hash/Recipe/load_recipe are stdlib-only, no comfy_client install required.
rendered_graph_hash_comparison.conclusion: assets/src/concept/signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.recipe.json is the genuine recipe -- re-rendering it through the same template reproduces the committed workflow_hash byte-for-byte. This is the deterministic check the card asked for; it needs no ComfyUI host and no surviving /history entry.

comfyui_history_lookup.conclusion: prompt_id has aged out of ComfyUI history (older T-0104-era sheet, host has cycled through many later runs since) -- moot once the rendered-graph hash comparison above proved authenticity by the stronger, deterministic method.

decision: generator set to the bare path assets/src/concept/signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.recipe.json (matching the convention of every other resolved concept-sheet record). generator_baseline.txt's src/concept/signal_tower_concept_sheet_v1.provenance.json line removed; the sheet now resolves on merit like the rest of assets/src/concept/.
